Liquid cooling for AI data centres · Toronto

Prefabricated liquid cooling and heat reuse for AI data centres.

We plan and design the liquid-cooled compute hall and deliver it as factory-built skids, CDUs, ORv3 racks and cooling plant. Across North America we also test, commission and maintain the liquid loop on site. Every boundary is handed over with its evidence.

What we do

Two things, and the records for both.

01

Prefabricated liquid cooling systems

We plan and design liquid-cooled AI data centres and deliver the cooling system as a coordinated package of four product families, with interfaces and acceptance criteria agreed before manufacture.

  • Prefabricated skids
  • ORv3 and 19-inch racks
  • CDUs
  • Cooling equipment
Four product families
02

Field testing, verification and operations

For liquid-cooled halls across North America, on systems we supplied and on systems we did not: four commissioning gates with written criteria, then a three-tier operations programme for the cooling loop, not the servers.

  • Four gates
  • Turnover package
  • Tiers 1–3
  • L0–L3 service levels
Field services in North America

The projects behind these figures

Plan the system before building it

Simulate the whole thermal path, boundary by boundary.

Selection, planning and design are informed by the whole loop: rack load, coolant temperatures, CDU approach, heat rejection and the heat you could reuse. Our concept simulator lets you pick a rack platform, a climate and a pipework layout, then watch junction temperature, flow, pressure drop and pPUE settle, and stress the design with load steps, pump loss or fouling.

Open the simulatorAll engineering tools

Concept model for planning and comparison. Not for equipment selection, acceptance or performance claims.
